description: This file contains a Kubernetes policy check implementation that enforces restrictions on the 'host' field in probes and lifecycle handlers within pod specifications, specifically for Kubernetes version 1.34 and above.

methods.name: hostProbesAndHostLifecycleV1Dot34
methods.description: Performs the check for forbidden 'host' fields in probes and lifecycle handlers in pod containers for Kubernetes v1.34+.

methods.name: getForbiddenHostProbes
methods.description: Returns a list of 'host' values from probes that are considered forbidden.

methods.name: getForbiddenHostLifecycle
methods.description: Returns a list of 'host' values from lifecycle handlers that are considered forbidden.
